verdict.rationale: RevenueCat offers some background automation primitives: scheduled data exports to cloud storage or email on a user-controlled schedule, and webhooks that fire automatically on app events. However, there is no evidence of a general automation or workflow builder, and the AI tools (MCP server, AI Toolkit, Rico) are interactive, not autonomous background agents. A community request for timed hooks, such as trial-expiry reminders, suggests time-based triggers were not supported. Missing for 10: a configurable automation/workflow builder, autonomous agent-driven background tasks, time-based triggers and actions, and independent corroboration.
